papers.title: The use of digital health tools in the management of inflammatory bowel disease: a systematic review
papers.authors: Meddi G, Mencaroni C, Schiavoni E, Ribaudi E, Amato S, Napolitano D
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, are chronic immune-mediated disorders characterized by a relapsing-remitting course and progressive intestinal damage with a significant impact on patients' quality of life and healthcare system. Traditional care models, based on periodic outpatient checkups, are often insufficient to ensure continuous disease monitoring and timely intervention in the event of a flare-up. In this context, the use of digital health tools represents a potentially innovative strategy to improve clinical and self-management of the disease. The aim of this systematic review is to investigate which digital health tools are currently used to support the management of patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
METHODS: This systematic review was conducted and reported in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Searches of PubMed, CINAHL, Web of Science, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were made covering literature from 2006 to 2025.
RESULTS: Fifteen articles were analyzed, paying attention to the themes of general characteristics, methodological quality, digital health tools utilized, topics of interest of the studies and acceptability and usability.
CONCLUSIONS: DHTs are promising tools for managing chronic conditions such as IBD, but require further refinement and adaptation to population-specific needs.

papers.title_zh: 數位健康工具於發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）管理之應用：系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），包括克隆氏症與潰瘍性大腸炎，是一種慢性免疫介導疾病，具有復發與緩解交替的病程及漸進性腸道損傷，對病人生活品質及醫療系統造成重大影響。傳統以定期門診追蹤為基礎的照護模式，往往不足以確保疾病的持續監測及在急性發作時的及時介入。在此背景下，數位健康工具的使用代表一種潛在的創新策略，可改善疾病的臨床照護與自我管理。本系統性回顧的目的為調查目前用於支持IBD（包括克隆氏症與潰瘍性大腸炎）病人管理的數位健康工具種類。
方法：本系統性回顧依循PRISMA 2020指引進行並撰寫報告。檢索PubMed、CINAHL、Web of Science、Scopus及Cochrane Library資料庫，涵蓋2006年至2025年之文獻。
結果：共分析15篇文章，聚焦於一般特徵、方法學品質、所使用之數位健康工具、研究主題及可接受度與可用性等議題。
結論：數位健康工具是管理如IBD等慢性疾病的具潛力工具，但仍需進一步精進並依人群特定需求調整。
papers.score_reason: 摘要僅為敘述性整理15篇文章、無統合分析與量化成效數據，且主題聚焦IBD自我管理數位工具而非大腸直腸外科議題，實用性極低。

papers.title: Comparison of surgical outcomes between robot-assisted and laparoscopic right colectomy for colon cancer: a single-center cohort study
papers.authors: Kasashima H, Fukuoka T, Naito N, Yonemitsu K, Seki Y, Kuroda K
papers.abstract: To assess the feasibility of robot-assisted right colectomy (RRC) for right-sided colon cancer by comparing its short-term surgical outcomes with those of laparoscopic right colectomy (LRC). We retrospectively reviewed consecutive patients undergoing elective right colectomy for stage I-III colon adenocarcinoma (LRC, n = 75; RRC, n = 50). The primary endpoint was overall 30-day postoperative morbidity; overall survival (OS), relapse-free survival (RFS), and other perioperative measures were secondary. A pre-specified exploratory analysis measured anastomotic time on intraoperative video in patients receiving an intracorporeal anastomosis (IA; robotic, n = 10; laparoscopic, n = 3). Median follow-up was 22.6 months. Baseline characteristics were balanced. Blood loss was lower with RRC (median 5 vs. 10 mL, p = 0.005), a clinically irrelevant difference, while operative time was longer (290 vs. 251 min, p = 0.05); setup and docking took a median of 24.5 min and console time 211.5 min. IA was used far more often in RRC (88.0% vs. 6.7%, p < 0.001). Morbidity, Clavien-Dindo grade ≥ III events, leakage, and hospital stay were similar. Robotic IA (n = 10) was faster than laparoscopic IA (n = 3; 33.4 vs. 40.7 min, p = 0.049), though underpowered. Neither OS nor RFS differed (log-rank p = 0.12 and 0.13). RRC was as safe as LRC perioperatively, with no difference in early OS or RFS, although the study was not powered for equivalence. The shorter robotic anastomotic time, observed despite greater institutional experience with laparoscopic IA, is hypothesis-generating and merits confirmation in adequately powered studies.

papers.title_zh: 機器人輔助與腹腔鏡右半結腸切除術治療大腸癌之手術預後比較：單中心世代研究
papers.abstract_zh: 為評估機器人輔助右半結腸切除術（RRC）用於右側大腸癌之可行性，本研究比較其短期手術結果與腹腔鏡右半結腸切除術（LRC）。我們回溯性檢視接受選擇性右半結腸切除術之第I-III期大腸腺癌連續病人（LRC組n=75；RRC組n=50）。主要終點為術後30天整體併發症率；次要終點包括整體存活（OS）、無復發存活（RFS）及其他手術週期指標。一項預先設定的探索性分析，針對接受體內吻合（IA）的病人，測量術中影片中的吻合時間（機器人組n=10；腹腔鏡組n=3）。中位追蹤時間為22.6個月。基線特徵組間平衡。RRC組出血量較低（中位數5 vs 10 mL，p=0.005），但此差異無臨床意義；手術時間較長（290 vs 251分鐘，p=0.05）；準備與對接時間中位數為24.5分鐘，操作台時間為211.5分鐘。RRC組使用IA的比例遠高於LRC組（88.0% vs 6.7%，p<0.001）。併發症率、Clavien-Dindo分級≥III事件、吻合口滲漏及住院天數兩組相似。機器人IA（n=10）比腹腔鏡IA（n=3）更快（33.4 vs 40.7分鐘，p=0.049），但檢定力不足。OS與RFS均無差異（log-rank p=0.12及0.13）。RRC在手術週期方面與LRC同樣安全，早期OS或RFS無差異，惟本研究並未針對等效性進行檢定力計算。機器人吻合時間較短的發現，即使在機構對腹腔鏡IA經驗更豐富的情況下仍觀察到，屬於假說產生性質，值得在檢定力充足的研究中進一步驗證。
papers.score_reason: 單中心小型回溯性研究，樣本量小且多項次分析（IA吻合時間僅10 vs 3人）明顯underpowered，主要結論多為陰性/無差異，臨床可信度與實用性有限。

papers.title: The gut microbiota-tryptophan metabolism-immune axis in inflammatory bowel disease: Mechanisms and therapeutic prospects
papers.authors: Wang T, Wang X, Yuan W
papers.abstract: The gut microbiota-tryptophan (TRP) metabolism-immune axis is one of the core pathogenic mechanisms in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Physiologically, gut microbes convert dietary TRP into bioactive metabolites that regulate intestinal immune balance and barrier function via AHR. In IBD, this axis enters a vicious cycle of dysbiosis, metabolic disruption, and immune imbalance - characterized by reduced beneficial bacteria, excessive 5‑HT production, and kynurenine pathway overactivation - which drives T‑cell dysregulation, aberrant macrophage polarization, and compromised barrier integrity. Therapeutic strategies are shifting from single‑target to integrated approaches, combining probiotics, engineered bacteria, AHR agonists, IDO1 inhibitors, immunomodulators, and ROS‑responsive nanomedicines. By achieving multi‑node synergistic remodeling, this review provides a theoretical foundation for systemic strategies that coordinate microbial regulation, metabolic intervention, and immune targeting, thereby offering new avenues for the effective treatment of IBD.

papers.title_zh: 腸道菌群-色胺酸(TRP)代謝-免疫軸在發炎性腸道疾病(IBD)中的角色：機轉與治療展望
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道菌群-色胺酸(TRP)代謝-免疫軸是發炎性腸道疾病(IBD)的核心致病機轉之一。在生理狀態下，腸道菌群將飲食中的色胺酸轉化為具生物活性的代謝物，透過芳香烴受體(AHR)調節腸道免疫平衡與屏障功能。在IBD中，此軸線進入菌群失衡、代謝紊亂與免疫失衡的惡性循環——特徵為有益菌減少、5-HT過度產生、以及犬尿氨酸路徑過度活化——進而驅動T細胞失調、巨噬細胞極化異常，以及屏障完整性受損。治療策略正從單一標靶轉向整合性方法，結合益生菌、工程菌、AHR促進劑、IDO1抑制劑、免疫調節劑，以及ROS反應性奈米藥物。透過達成多節點協同重塑，本綜述為協調菌群調控、代謝干預與免疫標靶之全身性策略提供理論基礎，為IBD的有效治療提供新途徑。

papers.title: Repositioning transanal total mesorectal excision in the robotic era
papers.authors: Li H, Shen T, Shen X
papers.abstract: Low rectal cancer lies deep in the pelvis, close to the pelvic autonomic nerves and urogenital structures. Surgery must therefore balance oncological clearance, sphincter preservation, and functional outcomes. Total mesorectal excision (TME) remains the fundamental oncological principle across open, laparoscopic, robotic, and transanal approaches. A deep, narrow male pelvis, obesity, a very low tumor, fibrosis after neoadjuvant treatment, and restricted distal transection can make transabdominal TME technically demanding. Robotic transabdominal TME (rTME) provides three-dimensional high-definition visualization, wristed instruments, tremor filtration, and a stable operating platform. These features address several limitations of conventional laparoscopy. rTME may therefore be suitable for most patients with mid-to-low rectal cancer when distal dissection and transection remain controllable from above. Against this background, the role of transanal total mesorectal excision (TaTME) should be reassessed rather than dismissed. Current evidence neither renders TaTME obsolete nor establishes a universal advantage across all low rectal cancers. Instead, TaTME is better positioned as a selective technical complement for very low tumors, restricted distal exposure or transection, and composite difficult-pelvis scenarios. At the same time, the development of robot-assisted TaTME (R-TaTME), hybrid TaTME, single-port robotic systems, and flexible transanal platforms offers new technological avenues. These platforms may improve procedural stability and instrument dexterity during transanal surgery. This review reappraises TaTME in the robotic era, focusing on indication refinement, pathological quality, training and quality assurance, functional preservation, and platform development.

papers.title_zh: 在機器人時代重新定位經肛門全直腸繫膜切除術（TaTME）
papers.abstract_zh: 低位直腸癌深藏於骨盆腔內，緊鄰骨盆自主神經與泌尿生殖結構。手術必須在腫瘤廓清、肛門括約肌保留與功能結果之間取得平衡。全直腸繫膜切除術（TME）仍是開腹、腹腔鏡、機器人與經肛門各種手術途徑共同遵循的腫瘤學基本原則。深窄的男性骨盆腔、肥胖、極低位腫瘤、新輔助治療後纖維化、以及遠端切線受限，都會使經腹TME在技術上更具挑戰性。經腹機器人TME（rTME）提供三維高解析度視野、腕式器械、震顫過濾與穩定操作平台，能改善傳統腹腔鏡的若干限制。因此，當遠端解剖與切線仍可由上方操作控制時，rTME可能適合大多數中低位直腸癌患者。在此背景下，經肛門全直腸繫膜切除術（TaTME）的角色應該被重新評估，而非直接放棄。目前證據既未使TaTME過時，也未證實其在所有低位直腸癌中具有普遍優勢。相反，TaTME更適合定位為針對極低位腫瘤、遠端顯露或切線受限、以及複合性困難骨盆情境的選擇性技術輔助手段。同時，機器人輔助TaTME（R-TaTME）、混合式TaTME、單孔機器人系統及可彎式經肛門平台等新技術發展，可能改善經肛門手術過程中的操作穩定性與器械靈活度。本綜述在機器人時代重新評估TaTME，聚焦於適應症精進、病理品質、訓練與品質保證、功能保留，以及平台發展。
papers.score_reason: 為敘述性綜述、非系統性方法學，無原始數據或統計分析，僅提供專家觀點整理，可作為臨床思路參考但不足以改變實務。
papers.relevance_why: 直接討論中低位直腸癌手術術式選擇（TaTME vs rTME），是台灣大腸直腸外科日常決策的核心議題。

papers.action: 可讀作觀點更新，了解R-TaTME、混合式TaTME等新平台發展趨勢；目前無新數據，實務決策仍依現有RCT結果。

papers.title: Cancer cell-selective ectopic expression of CD20 as an antigen enables rituximab repurposing for solid tumour immunotherapy
papers.authors: Kong Z, Wang Y, Zhao Y, Wang L, Fan Z, Shu Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Despite the clinical success of cancer immunotherapies, their efficacy is often compromised by antigen-related problems, including downregulation, loss, and off-tumour toxicity.
METHODS: To overcome these limitations that challenge the current immunotherapies dependent on native antigens, we here describe a new cancer immunotherapy strategy that artificially and specifically expresses a clinically validated antigen on variant tumours and thus repurposes clinical antibody drugs to treat cancers not belonging to their indications. To authenticate the strategy, we delivered a CD20 gene under the control of an NF-κB-specific promoter to tumours by adeno-associated virus and then treated them with a CD20 antibody, rituximab.
RESULTS: We found that CD20 was selectively expressed in tumours, and subsequent rituximab treatment engaged multiple antibody-dependent effector mechanisms, including NK-cell-mediated ADCC and macrophage-mediated ADCP. We demonstrated that this strategy is effective not only in variant-cultivated cancer cells, HCT116 spheroids, and patient-derived organoids of human colorectal cancer, but also in a humanized mouse with an HCT116 xenograft and immunocompetent mouse with an MC38 transplant. The strategy showed high cancer cell specificity in both in vitro and in vivo models, resulting in high therapeutic efficacy.
CONCLUSION: This strategy thus creates a new modality of cancer immune-redirection therapy by repurposing both the clinically validated antigen and antibody.
KEY POINTS: TRAP enables tumour-selective ectopic expression of the clinically validated antigen CD20, overcoming antigen limitations in solid tumour immunotherapy. TRAP repurposes anti-CD20 antibodies to engage diverse immune effector mechanisms, including ADCC, ADCP, and CDC. TRAP demonstrates antitumour efficacy across cellular, 3D tumour spheroid, patient-derived organoid, and in vivo solid tumour models.
papers.title_zh: 癌細胞選擇性異位表現CD20作為抗原，使rituximab得以重新應用於實體腫瘤免疫治療
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：儘管癌症免疫治療已獲得臨床成功，但其療效常因抗原相關問題而受損，包括抗原下調、喪失，以及非腫瘤毒性。方法：為克服目前依賴原生抗原之免疫治療所面臨的這些限制，我們在此描述一種新的癌症免疫治療策略，此策略能人工且特異性地在變異腫瘤上表現一個經臨床驗證的抗原，從而將臨床抗體藥物重新應用於治療非其原適應症之癌症。為驗證此策略，我們利用腺相關病毒（AAV）將CD20基因置於NF-κB特異性啟動子控制下遞送至腫瘤，然後以CD20抗體rituximab進行治療。結果：我們發現CD20被選擇性地表現於腫瘤中，隨後的rituximab治療啟動了多種抗體依賴性效應機制，包括NK細胞介導的ADCC與巨噬細胞介導的ADCP。我們證實此策略不僅在變異培養的癌細胞、HCT116球狀體及人類大腸直腸癌患者衍生類器官中有效，在具有HCT116異體移植之人源化小鼠及具有MC38移植之免疫功能完整小鼠中亦有效。此策略在體外及體內模型中均展現高度癌細胞特異性，並產生高治療效力。結論：此策略透過重新應用經臨床驗證的抗原及抗體，創造了一種新型態的癌症免疫重新導向治療模式。重點：TRAP使腫瘤選擇性異位表現經臨床驗證的抗原CD20成為可能，克服實體腫瘤免疫治療中的抗原限制。TRAP重新應用抗CD20抗體以啟動多種免疫效應機制，包括ADCC、ADCP及CDC。TRAP在細胞、3D腫瘤球狀體、患者衍生類器官及體內實體腫瘤模型中展現抗腫瘤療效。

papers.title: BRAF V600E-Mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: Practical Management in the Post-BREAKWATER Era
papers.authors: Sagawa T, Nagashima H, Fujikawa K
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: BRAF V600E-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) is a biologically distinct subtype characterized by right-sided predominance, frequent overlap with serrated-pathway biology, and historically poor outcomes with conventional chemotherapy. Therapeutic progress has been driven by the recognition that BRAF inhibition alone is inadequate in colorectal cancer because adaptive epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-mediated feedback rapidly restores MAPK signaling.
METHODS: This narrative review evaluates the clinical development and practical integration of BRAF-targeted therapy in BRAF V600E-mutated mCRC, with particular emphasis on first-line treatment, MMR/MSI status, patient fitness, and treatment sequencing in the post-BREAKWATER era.
RESULTS: Combined BRAF and EGFR inhibition established encorafenib plus cetuximab as a standard option after prior therapy. The phase 3 BREAKWATER program has now moved BRAF-targeted treatment into first-line practice by demonstrating improved outcomes with encorafenib plus cetuximab combined with fluoropyrimidine-basedchemotherapy, including mFOLFOX6 and FOLFIRI backbones. These data define a chemo-targeted approach for fit patients with non-MSI-H/dMMR disease. For MSI-H/dMMR tumors, first-line immune checkpoint blockade should be prioritized irrespective of BRAF V600E status unless immunotherapy is absolutely contraindicated.
CONCLUSION: Important uncertainties remain regarding whether BRAF/EGFR targeting should be added to immunotherapy in MSI-H/dMMR disease, as well as the management of frail or oxaliplatin-ineligible patients, maintenance therapy, local treatment integration, and sequencing after frontline encorafenib exposure. Treatment selection in the post- BREAKWATER era should therefore integrate molecular context, patient fitness, and remaining evidence gaps.

papers.title_zh: BRAF V600E突變轉移性大腸直腸癌：後BREAKWATER時代的實務處置
papers.abstract_zh: 前言：BRAF V600E突變轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）是生物學上獨特的亞型，以右側腫瘤為主、常與serrated pathway生物學重疊，傳統化療預後不佳。治療進展源自於認知到單獨BRAF抑制在大腸直腸癌中並不足夠，因為適應性表皮生長因子受體（EGFR）媒介的回饋機制會迅速恢復MAPK訊號傳導。方法：本敘述性綜述評估BRAF標靶治療在BRAF V600E突變mCRC中的臨床發展與實務整合，特別聚焦於一線治療、MMR/MSI狀態、病人體能狀況，以及後BREAKWATER時代的治療排序。結果：BRAF與EGFR聯合抑制已確立encorafenib加cetuximab為先前治療後的標準選項之一。第三期BREAKWATER試驗計畫現已將BRAF標靶治療推進至一線臨床實務，證實encorafenib加cetuximab併用fluoropyrimidine為基礎的化療（包括mFOLFOX6與FOLFIRI骨架）可改善治療結果。這些數據為體能良好、非MSI-H/dMMR疾病的病人定義出一種化療加標靶的治療策略。對於MSI-H/dMMR腫瘤，無論BRAF V600E狀態如何，除非免疫治療絕對禁忌，一線免疫檢查點阻斷治療應優先考慮。結論：仍存在重要的不確定性，包括MSI-H/dMMR疾病中是否應在免疫治療上加入BRAF/EGFR標靶治療、體能虛弱或不適合使用oxaliplatin病人的處置、維持治療、局部治療的整合，以及一線使用encorafenib後的後續治療排序。後BREAKWATER時代的治療選擇因此應整合分子背景、病人體能狀況與現存的證據缺口。

papers.title: Establishing the Median Effective Dose of Tegileridine for Immediate Postoperative Analgesia Following Laparoscopic Colorectal Cancer Surgery: A Sequential Dose-Finding Study
papers.authors: Guo M, Wang T, Lin S, Hu H, Hou J, Zhang C
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: To determine the median effective dose (ED50) of tegileridine for immediate postoperative analgesia following laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery (LCRS), and to evaluate its safety profile.
METHODS: A modified Dixon's up-and-down sequential method was employed, starting with an initial tegileridine dose of 15 µg/kg and a dose ratio of 1:1.1. Patients undergoing elective LCRS received a standardized multimodal analgesic background, including a transversus abdominis plane block and intraoperative sufentanil, and received intravenous tegileridine 10 minutes before the end of surgery. A blinded investigator assessed pain using the Numerical Rating Scale (NRS) at 15 and 30 minutes, and 2 hours post-extubation. Effective analgesia was defined as an NRS score ≤ 3 without rescue analgesia within 2 hours. The ED50 was calculated using probit regression analysis. Hemodynamic variables and adverse events were documented, and safety was followed until postoperative day 2.
RESULTS: Analysis of the 40 patients revealed that the ED50 of tegileridine for LCRS was 7.311 μg/kg (95% confidence interval [CI]: 2.044 to 9.194). Adverse events were mild and no serious adverse events were observed. In the PACU, 5/40 patients (12.5%) experienced adverse events (hypoxaemia, nausea, vomiting, and dizziness). By postoperative day 2, the cumulative incidence was 17.5% (predominantly dizziness and nausea).
CONCLUSION: This exploratory study provides a preliminary ED50 estimate for tegileridine in immediate post-LCRS analgesia within a multimodal regimen, with a favorable short-term safety profile. However, the wide CI limits these findings; larger studies are needed to validate dose-response relationships and better define clinically relevant effective doses.

papers.title_zh: 確立特格利定（tegileridine）用於腹腔鏡大腸直腸癌手術後即時止痛之半數有效劑量：序列劑量遞增研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在確立特格利定用於腹腔鏡大腸直腸癌手術（LCRS）後即時止痛之半數有效劑量（ED50），並評估其安全性。方法：採用改良式 Dixon up-and-down 序列法，初始劑量為 15 µg/kg，劑量比為 1:1.1。接受選擇性 LCRS 的病人接受標準化多模式止痛方案，包括腹橫肌平面阻斷及術中舒芬太尼，並於手術結束前 10 分鐘靜脈給予特格利定。盲化研究者於拔管後 15 分鐘、30 分鐘及 2 小時以數字疼痛評分量表（NRS）評估疼痛。有效止痛定義為 2 小時內 NRS ≤ 3 且未使用救援止痛藥。ED50 以 probit 回歸分析計算。記錄血流動力學變數與不良事件，並追蹤安全性至術後第 2 天。結果：分析 40 名病人後發現，特格利定用於 LCRS 之 ED50 為 7.311 μg/kg（95% 信賴區間：2.044 至 9.194）。不良事件皆屬輕微，未觀察到嚴重不良事件。於恢復室（PACU）中，5/40 名病人（12.5%）發生不良事件（低血氧、噁心、嘔吐及暈眩）。至術後第 2 天，累積發生率為 17.5%（主要為暈眩及噁心）。結論：本探索性研究提供特格利定於多模式方案中用於 LCRS 術後即時止痛之初步 ED50 估計值，短期安全性尚可。然而信賴區間過寬限制了此結果之推論，需要更大規模研究以驗證劑量-反應關係並更明確定義臨床相關有效劑量。

papers.title: Exploring spiritual needs in inflammatory bowel disease: a qualitative study protocol adopting the think-aloud method
papers.authors: Martinato M, Tasson L, Bonato M, Varagnolo C, Monaco E, Lorenzon G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Spirituality may influence coping and quality of life in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), yet spiritual needs are rarely assessed systematically in routine care. The Spiritual Needs Questionnaire - Extended Version (SpNQ-EV) and the Interpretation of Illness Questionnaire (IIQ) explore spiritual needs and illness meanings but require cross-cultural adaptation and content validation for use in the Italian IBD context.
METHODS: This protocol describes a qualitative questionnaire validation study using think-aloud cognitive interviews. Purposive sampling with planned heterogeneity and saturation-based stopping will be used to recruit adult IBD patients and healthcare professionals from two Italian IBD outpatient centers. Participants will complete the Italian versions of the questionnaires while verbalizing their thoughts, followed by retrospective probing guided by Tourangeau's cognitive model and a brief debriefing. Interviews will be audio-recorded, anonymized, and analyzed item-by-item in a matrix using predefined problem codes complemented by inductive coding. Inter-coder reliability will be assessed on a subset of transcripts; AI-assisted coding will be explored using de-identified text under human oversight.
RESULTS: As this manuscript represents a research protocol, no empirical results have been generated at this stage. This protocol describes a structured approach to evaluating the content validity of two questionnaires, emphasizing transparency in translation, cognitive testing, and item-revision decision rules. The combined use of concurrent think-aloud and retrospective probing will enable observation of real-time cognitive processes and clarification of ambiguous responses. The inclusion of both patients and healthcare professionals will provide complementary perspectives. The exploratory use of AI-assisted coding may offer efficiencies for segment classification in large item-by-item matrices.
CONCLUSIONS: Rigorously adapted and content-validated Italian versions of the SpNQ-EV and IIQ may support both research and clinical practice by providing a shared language for exploring existential and spiritual dimensions of living with IBD, supporting future psychometric validation and implementation of spiritual and interpretation of illness assessment.
papers.title_zh: 探索發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者的靈性需求：採用「有聲思考法」的質性研究計畫書
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：靈性可能影響發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者的應對能力與生活品質，然而靈性需求在常規照護中很少被系統性評估。靈性需求問卷擴展版（SpNQ-EV）與疾病詮釋問卷（IIQ）可探討靈性需求與疾病意義，但在義大利IBD情境下使用前，需要進行跨文化調適與內容效度驗證。方法：本計畫書描述一項採用有聲思考法認知訪談的問卷驗證質性研究。將採用目的性取樣、預先規劃異質性、並以資料飽和作為停止收案準則，從兩個義大利IBD門診中心招募成年IBD患者與醫療專業人員。參與者將在完成義大利語版問卷的同時口頭表達其思考過程，隨後依循Tourangeau認知模型進行回溯式探詢，並進行簡短的訪後討論。訪談將全程錄音、去識別化，並以預先定義的問題編碼結合歸納式編碼，逐題進行矩陣分析。將於部分逐字稿中評估編碼者間信度；並將在人工監督下，探索以去識別化文本進行AI輔助編碼。結果：由於本文為研究計畫書，目前尚無實證結果產出。本計畫書描述了一套用於評估兩份問卷內容效度的結構化方法，強調翻譯、認知測試與題項修訂決策規則的透明度。同時採用即時有聲思考法與回溯式探詢，將有助於觀察即時認知過程並釐清模糊回應。納入患者與醫療專業人員雙方，將提供互補的觀點。AI輔助編碼的探索性應用，可能為大型逐題矩陣的段落分類提供效率上的助益。結論：經嚴謹調適並完成內容效度驗證的義大利語版SpNQ-EV與IIQ，可望支持研究與臨床實務，為探討IBD患者存在與靈性層面提供共通語言，並為未來心理計量驗證與靈性及疾病詮釋評估之落實奠定基礎。

papers.title: Longitudinal effects of a nurse-led self-management intervention in inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Rivera-Sequeiros A, Torres-Dominguez Y, Izquierdo-Macias M, Murciano-Gonzalo F, Milanes-Guisado Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Despite its significant psychological burden, long-term psychosocial effects of nurse-led self-management interventions in IBD remain understudied. This study assessed longitudinal changes in psychosocial outcomes following a structured self-management program, and the moderating role of family functioning.
METHODS: A single-center, non-randomized, single-arm longitudinal study was conducted in 60 IBD adults in remission who participated in a nurse-led multidisciplinary psychoeducational program in Spain. HRQoL (CCVEII-9), perceived stress (PSS-14), anxiety and depression (HADS), and family functioning (Family APGAR) were assessed at five time points over 12 months. Linear mixed-effects models evaluated temporal changes and moderating role of baseline family functioning.
RESULTS: HRQoL improved significantly over 12 months (β=+6.18, 95% CI: 3.53 to 8.82; P<0.001), exceeding a clinically meaningful threshold. Depressive symptoms showed a significant sustained reduction (P=0.036; β=-0.92, 95% CI: -1.66 to -0.19 at 12 months). Perceived stress showed a non-significant decreasing trend (P=0.054), reaching significance at 6 months (β=-1.93, 95% CI: -3.63 to -0.22; P=0.028). Anxiety remained stable (P=0.471). Family functioning moderated trajectories for perceived stress (P=0.004), depression (P<0.001), and anxiety (P<0.001), with a non-significant trend for HRQoL (P=0.056); participants with normal family functioning showed earlier and stronger improvements.
CONCLUSIONS: Longitudinal evidence suggests that a nurse-led psychoeducational intervention was associated with sustained improvements in HRQoL and depressive symptoms in IBD. The moderating role of family functioning in outcomes underscores the value of integrating family-sensitive self-management programs into IBD nursing care.
papers.title_zh: 護理師主導的自我管理介入對發炎性腸道疾病患者的縱向影響
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：儘管發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）帶來顯著的心理負擔，護理師主導的自我管理介入之長期心理社會效應仍未被充分研究。本研究評估結構化自我管理計畫後心理社會結果的縱向變化，以及家庭功能的調節作用。
方法：本單中心、非隨機、單組縱向研究於西班牙納入60名處於緩解期的IBD成年患者，參與護理師主導之多學科心理教育計畫。於12個月內五個時間點評估健康相關生活品質（HRQoL, CCVEII-9）、感知壓力（PSS-14）、焦慮與憂鬱（HADS）以及家庭功能（Family APGAR）。以線性混合效應模型評估時間變化及基準家庭功能的調節作用。
結果：HRQoL在12個月內顯著改善（β=+6.18，95% CI：3.53 至 8.82；P<0.001），超過臨床有意義的門檻。憂鬱症狀顯示顯著且持續的降低（P=0.036；12個月時 β=-0.92，95% CI：-1.66 至 -0.19）。感知壓力呈現不顯著的下降趨勢（P=0.054），於6個月時達到顯著（β=-1.93，95% CI：-3.63 至 -0.22；P=0.028）。焦慮則維持穩定（P=0.471）。家庭功能對感知壓力（P=0.004）、憂鬱（P<0.001）及焦慮（P<0.001）的軌跡具調節作用，對HRQoL則呈不顯著趨勢（P=0.056）；家庭功能正常的參與者顯示更早且更強的改善。
結論：縱向證據顯示護理師主導的心理教育介入與IBD患者HRQoL及憂鬱症狀的持續改善相關。家庭功能在結果中的調節作用，凸顯將家庭敏感型自我管理計畫納入IBD護理照護的價值。

papers.title: Building on Routinely Collected Health Data for Precision Population Care in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
papers.abstract: The growing burden of multimorbidity among individuals with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) presents a critical challenge for health systems, as it signals the need to shift from single-disease-focused care to integrated multimorbidity-focused care. Recent Canadian population-based research has demonstrated that multimorbidity in IBD follows distinct patterns and that these patterns can be leveraged using machine learning (ML) to predict premature mortality. This column draws on two recent studies evaluating populations with IBD - one identifying multimorbidity clustering among individuals with IBD and another applying ML to predict premature death from non-IBD chronic conditions - to explore how these findings can inform health system planning, clinical care and policy decision-making.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者中日益加重的多重共病負擔，對醫療系統構成重大挑戰，顯示需從單一疾病導向照護轉變為整合性多重共病導向照護。近期加拿大以人群為基礎的研究顯示，IBD 中的多重共病呈現特定模式，且可利用機器學習（ML）運用這些模式來預測早期死亡。本專欄文章援引兩篇近期評估 IBD 人群的研究——一篇辨識 IBD 患者中的多重共病聚集模式，另一篇應用機器學習預測非 IBD 慢性疾病導致的早期死亡——探討這些發現如何用於健康系統規劃、臨床照護與政策決策。
